title: Best Shinco Dehumidifier (2026): Reviews, Models & Recalls
dek: A marketplace budget brand with a clean recall record — and prices that swing wildly from one listing to the next.
description: The best Shinco dehumidifier for every space — 30-, 50-, 120- and 200-pint models reviewed, plus pricing quirks, manual help and Shinco’s recall record.
intro: A **Shinco dehumidifier** is the kind of appliance you mostly find through Walmart, Newegg and other online marketplaces rather than on a big-box store floor. Shinco is a budget brand, and its current U.S. lineup covers four capacity tiers, from a 30-pint bedroom unit to a 200-pint industrial machine — several of them ENERGY STAR certified.

Two things set Shinco apart before you even look at specs. First, its name doesn’t appear on either of the two largest dehumidifier recall lists in U.S. history, which together cover dozens of other brands. Second, the same model can be listed at wildly different prices depending on where you shop — sometimes more than double.
Here’s which Shinco to buy for each space, and how to shop the brand without overpaying.
topPicksLead: For a whole basement or large open area, the **Shinco 120-Pint ENERGY STAR Wi-Fi** is the pick, with remote humidity and tank monitoring and coverage rated up to 6,000 square feet.

products.name: Shinco 120-Pint ENERGY STAR Wi-Fi Dehumidifier
pros: Largest coverage in Shinco’s consumer lineup
Wi-Fi app shows humidity and tank status
cons: Capacity is a maximum rating, not a DOE figure
products.whyWeLoveIt: It’s the Shinco that can handle a full basement, and the app means you can check whether the tank is full without walking downstairs.
products.performance: Shinco rates it for up to 6,000 square feet with a 1.32-gallon internal tank, and it appears in ENERGY STAR’s certified-product database. The 120-pint figure is a maximum rating rather than the DOE number most mainstream brands print, so compare it carefully against other units. See more large-space options in our [best whole-house dehumidifier](/best/best-whole-house-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Shinco 50-Pint Dehumidifier (YDP-50P)
products.whyWeLoveIt: It covers the classic damp-basement job with the features that matter there: auto-defrost for cool floors and a shutoff that keeps it from overflowing when no one’s around.
products.performance: Shinco rates it for a mid-size basement or multi-room area of up to about 2,500 square feet. The unusual option to wall-mount it can free floor space in a utility room. Compare it with mainstream rivals in our [best 50-pint dehumidifier](/best/best-50-pint-dehumidifier/) roundup.

products.name: Shinco 30-Pint Dehumidifier (SDL-30P)
cons: Biggest price spread in the lineup
Not enough for a full basement
products.whyWeLoveIt: For a bedroom, home office or small apartment, this is the most affordable way into the brand — just shop carefully, because its listed price can vary dramatically.
products.performance: Shinco rates it for up to 1,500 square feet, though that claim is generous for a 30-pint unit; treat it as a one- or two-room machine. A timer and an optional drain port add flexibility. More inexpensive options in our [best budget dehumidifier](/best/best-budget-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Shinco 200-Pint Industrial Dehumidifier
pros: Built-in drain hose for continuous operation
Fills a job-site tier many budget brands skip
cons: Far too large for most homes
products.whyWeLoveIt: It’s the only Shinco designed around unattended running rather than a bucket, which is exactly what a warehouse, job site or restoration project needs.
products.performance: Shinco rates it at up to 200 pints a day for large and commercial spaces, with drainage built in from the start. For a broader set of heavy-duty machines, see our [best commercial dehumidifier](/best/best-commercial-dehumidifier/) guide.

sections.heading: How we pick the best Shinco dehumidifiers

blocks.text: We don’t lab-test. We compared Shinco’s published capacity and coverage claims, ENERGY STAR database listings and retailer spec sheets, then searched CPSC recall notices by brand and model. We read owner reviews across marketplaces for recurring issues and noted where listings for the same model disagreed.
Because Shinco’s capacity figures are often maximum ratings rather than DOE-tested numbers, we sized each pick conservatively and matched it to the space it can realistically handle.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Shinco dehumidifier

items.label: Coverage, sized conservatively
items.text: Use the [dehumidifier size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/) rather than the box claim to choose between the 30, 50 and 120.

items.label: The same model at a better price
items.text: Check at least two storefronts. Identical model numbers have been listed at less than half the price elsewhere.

items.label: ENERGY STAR on the exact listing
items.text: Match the full model number in the ENERGY STAR database; some Shinco units are co-listed with near-identical Yoau and UHOME models.

items.label: Drainage you can live with
items.text: Only the 200-pint ships built around a hose. Smaller models are bucket-first, with a drain port on some listings.

items.label: A known seller
items.text: Marketplace listings vary in warranty support. Buy from a seller that clearly states return and warranty terms.

sections.heading: Shinco and the big dehumidifier recalls

blocks.text: Two recalls account for most dehumidifier fire-hazard headlines of the past decade, and Shinco isn’t named in either:

items: **Gree-built units (2013, reannounced 2016 and 2023):** about 2.5 million dehumidifiers sold under 13 brand names, linked to more than 450 fires and $19 million in property damage.
**New Widetech-built units (2021):** roughly 2 million dehumidifiers sold from 2009 to 2017 under about 20 brand names, including Danby, Amana, Friedrich and Haier.

blocks.title: Still check the model number
blocks.text: A clean record isn’t a guarantee for the future. Before buying any used or unfamiliar listing, search the exact model number on CPSC.gov.

sections.heading: Shinco dehumidifier reviews, manuals and support

blocks.text: Because Shinco sells mainly through marketplaces, its reviews are scattered across many listings — and some listings bundle different models together. Read reviews on the exact model number you’re buying, and look for patterns over time (tank leaks, noisy fans, units that stop collecting water) rather than star averages.

Start with the product listing where you bought it — many marketplace pages link a PDF manual — and keep the printed manual that ships in the box. If you’ve lost it, search the full model number from the label on the back of the unit. If your Shinco has stopped pulling water, our [dehumidifier not collecting water](/guides/dehumidifier-not-collecting-water/) guide covers the usual fixes.

The **Shinco 120-Pint ENERGY STAR Wi-Fi** is the best pick for whole-basement coverage with remote monitoring. Choose the **50-Pint YDP-50P** for a typical basement, the **30-Pint SDL-30P** for a bedroom or apartment and the **200-Pint Industrial** for commercial jobs. Whichever you pick, compare a few listings first — the price spread is real money — and take comfort that Shinco isn’t on either major recall list. To see how Shinco stacks up against bigger names, visit our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) ranking.

faqs.q: What is the best Shinco dehumidifier?
faqs.a: The 120-Pint ENERGY STAR Wi-Fi model for whole-basement coverage. Choose the 50-Pint (YDP-50P) for a mid-size basement, the 30-Pint (SDL-30P) for a bedroom or apartment, and the 200-Pint Industrial for commercial spaces.

faqs.q: Is Shinco a good dehumidifier brand?
faqs.a: It’s a reasonable budget option with several ENERGY STAR models and no appearances on the major recall lists. It lacks the retail presence and service network of Frigidaire or Midea, so buy from a seller with clear warranty terms.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Shinco dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Check the listing where you bought it for a PDF link, or search the full model number from the unit’s back label. Keep the printed manual that ships in the box for filter and drain-hose instructions.

faqs.q: Has Shinco ever recalled a dehumidifier?
faqs.a: Not according to CPSC.gov. Shinco isn’t listed in the Gree-built recall (13 brands) or the 2021 New Widetech recall (about 20 brands). Always check the exact model number on a used unit.

faqs.q: Why do Shinco dehumidifier prices vary so much?
faqs.a: Shinco sells mostly through third-party marketplace sellers, so there’s no single controlled price. The same model can appear at less than half the price on another storefront.

faqs.q: Does Shinco make a dehumidifier with a drain hose?
faqs.a: The 200-Pint Industrial ships with a built-in drain hose. The 30- and 120-pint models offer an optional continuous-drain port on several listings; check the exact spec sheet before buying.
